newsitem.title: SWEDEN: One man dies in Sweden from bootleg liquor.
newsitem.headline: One man dies in Sweden from bootleg liquor.

text.p: One man died and a 17-year girl was fighting for her life on Wednesday after a group of Swedish teenagers celebrated the New Year with a bottle of lethal bootleg liquor, Swedish police said.
Ten friends, aged between 14 and 20, were celebrating the New Year at Ljustero outside Stockholm with a bottle of alcohol taken from the printing works where one of the group worked.
But the bottle contained methanol, a police spokesman told the tabloid newspaper Aftonbladet.
A 20-year-old man died after drinking the concoction and five others needed hospital treatment.
One girl remained in a critical condition in hospital on Wednesday.
Swedish authorities impose high taxes on alcohol in a move to discourage consumption and raise taxes but the high prices in shops and bars as led to a black market in homemade illegal liquor.
